answer: Each identity files one unique 2-gigabyte shard and hash at one inlet with a 60-credit bond. The raven beacon issues three random retrieval challenges per epoch, each served within 90 seconds by zenith. The inlet auditor checks served bytes: a miss slashes 20, three misses burn the bond. Shards derive from key plus seed, so each identity needs its own shard. The k-th fake costs 68 plus a 200-credit operator bond per 12; 1,000 fakes cost 84,800. A rented-disk ring fails: only the holder can serve the named bytes in time. An honest agent pays one refundable 60-credit bond and 8 per epoch.
